【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Spiking neural networks (SNNs), as core models of brain-inspired computing, simulate the computational mechanisms of biological neural systems.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《A dual-time-scale cooperative memory mechanism for spiking neural networks》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】However, existing models lack the division of labor and collaboration mechanisms found in biological fast and slow neural populations, making it difficult for single-timescale neural populations to simultaneously capture transient events and maintain long-term dependencies.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】In the classification experiments, the model achieved accuracy rates of 99.78%, 96.26%, 98.26% and 99.26%, respectively, outperforming single-pooling baselines with comparable parameter scales.

evidence.text: However, existing models lack the division of labor and collaboration mechanisms found in biological fast and slow neural populations, making it difficult for single-timescale neural populations to simultaneously capture transient events and maintain long-term dependencies.
In the classification experiments, the model achieved accuracy rates of 99.78%, 96.26%, 98.26% and 99.26%, respectively, outperforming single-pooling baselines with comparable parameter scales.
